request.description: Declines an offer. `reason`: `outside_service_area`, `category_not_handled`, `capacity_full`, `conflict_of_interest` or `other` (then `note` is required). The lead goes to the next CA straight away and is never offered to this firm again. Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.
